name: Jergosh the Invoker
summary: Jergosh the Invoker is a treacherous orc warlock hiding deep within Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. As a high-ranking leader among the Searing Blade cultists, he practices demonic arts directly under the Warchief's nose and plots against the Horde.

sections.title: A Cult Beneath the City
sections.body: While Thrall works tirelessly to lead the orcs along a path of honor and shamanism, Jergosh rejected these ideals in favor of raw demonic power. Concealing himself within the subterranean labyrinth of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, he gathered followers into the Searing Blade, an insidious sect aligned with the remnants of the Shadow Council. Operating in the shadows directly below the Horde capital, Jergosh works to undo everything the new Horde stands for.

sections.title: Demonic Ambitions
sections.body: Jergosh's presence in the chasm is far from aimless wandering. His dark rituals and dangerous schemes eventually grew bold enough to attract the direct scrutiny of Thrall himself. Jergosh represents an existential infection within Durotar, reminding the Horde of the dark pacts they fought so desperately to leave behind.

faq.answer: Jergosh the Invoker is a powerful orc warlock and a leader of the Searing Blade cultists operating within Ragefire Chasm. Rather than following Thrall's honorable path, he chose to embrace demonic sorcery.

faq.q: Why is Jergosh hiding in Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Ragefire Chasm provides the Searing Blade with a secluded network of fiery caverns directly beneath Orgrimmar. From there, Jergosh and his cultists can practice forbidden dark magic and conspire against the Horde undetected.

faq.q: What faction does Jergosh belong to?
faq.answer: Jergosh is a leader within the Searing Blade, a cult linked to the Shadow Council and devoted to serving demonic interests like the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Does Thrall know Jergosh is beneath Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Yes. Jergosh's plots grew dangerous enough that rumors reached Thrall, leading the Warchief to dispatch trusted adventurers into the chasm to eliminate the cultist menace.

faq.q: Why does Jergosh practice fel magic instead of shamanism?
faq.answer: Jergosh willingly turned his back on the spiritual resurgence of his people, rejecting shamanistic harmony to chase the intoxicating power promised by the Burning Legion and dark arts.

angles.text: Jergosh represents the lingering poison of the old Horde—the temptation of demonic blood and sorcery that Thrall strives to purge from orcish culture.
For warlocks, Jergosh is a powerful practitioner of the demonic arts whose schemes threaten the Horde.
Having a Shadow Council cell thriving beneath the chieftain's throne room is an intolerable security threat that the Horde cannot afford to ignore.
